content: We decided to use Rust for the recall rebuild because fastembed-rs gives native local embeddings without CGO overhead
Good choice. Rust with fastembed-rs avoids the CGO complexity of Go while giving us the same BGE-small-en-v1.5 model with sub-4ms embedding times. I'll set up the project structure now.
The scan cache uses mtime plus file size as a fast check before computing SHA-256 hashes of changed files
That two-level approach means we only hash files where metadata actually changed. For 2600 files on NTFS, the stat scan alone takes about 42ms with jwalk parallel walking.
